text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso's voice was trembling. Her hands 
were clenched tightly together.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"The journey we must walk, the future 
beyond Funabashi... is still far away."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I knew that. I should have known that, and 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I searched for words of encouragement, 
Furioso suddenly looked up.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes—and that is precisely why this chest 
burns so fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It is difficult, and that is precisely why 
we must win.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Otherwise, we can never change 
Funabashi's present."
choice_data_list: Furioso will pave the way to the future!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"We chose a path that no one has ever 
walked before. To prove Funabashi's 
strength, and its future... right here."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I'll keep trying again and 
again. Even if it's a path strewn with 
thorns.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I will show you I can do it. 
Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
For Funabashi's sake. And for your sake, 
who has supported me all this time.
